scope: Prospective addition before semantic validation, generation or model scores. Distinguish pooled evidence of signal from uniform conditioned engineering admission. No reduction of previous admission requirements or authorization for G3.

level1.name: POOLED_AXIS_SIGNAL_SCREEN
level1.estimator: Three dedicated pooled binary logistic probes on all known TRAIN rows, same frozen normalized H38N7 features, C=1, L2, lbfgs, fit_intercept=false, max_iter=2000, tol=1e-8; balanced known labels. HOLD uses existing class_weight=balanced and balanced accuracy. Retain nine-way probe and G2 comparisons unchanged; new pooled binary probe is a diagnostic auxiliary, not deployed model. Evaluate all on same EVAL families, no tuning.
level1.family_unit: For each semantic axis use each family's mean of its 8 binary correctness indicators. For HOLD use half of within-family known recall (8 rows) plus half of within-family HOLD recall (2 rows). Average over families; equal cell counts give pooled balanced accuracy. No pooling of HOLD into axes.
level1.inference: Four pooled signal tests against mean family score <=.5, Holm step-down at family-wise alpha=.05 only with valid individual p-values under explicitly justified sampling assumptions. Conservative prespecified bounded-score Hoeffding p=min(1,exp(-2*F_eval*max(mean-.5,0)^2)) if independent EVAL families and null mean assumptions defensible, conditional on fitted model. Report raw p, Holm adjusted p, effect and family-level uncertainty; if independence/sampling unsupported, DESCRIPTIVE_SIGNAL_ONLY, no inferential PASS. Same-author synthetic construction sample does not establish natural-language population inference. No row-level binomial p as empirical primary result.
level1.interpretation: Pooled evidence above chance does not imply every conditioned context works or that 80% engineering target is met. Label POOLED_SIGNAL_DETECTED only when valid test passes, otherwise POOLED_SIGNAL_INCONCLUSIVE; descriptive evidence always reported.

level2.name: CONDITIONED_HETEROGENEITY_AND_ENGINEERING_GATES
level2.definition: 3 axes x 4 fixed remaining-factor combinations; per-combo confusion, coverage, G2 underlying/raw/end-to-end, conditional probe BA, exact collision ceiling, collision rates, gap/convergence. Report descriptive family uncertainty; no pooled test can hide a weak context. Preserve original v3 strict per-context admission criteria incl point BA>=.8, exact U>=.8, conflict rate<.01, adjusted bootstrap lower bound>.5 at .05/13 and other integrity gates; approximate engineering criteria, not exact FWER claim. HOLD separate original gate. If pooled positive but any context fails, POOLED_SIGNAL__CONTEXT_ADMISSION_HOLD. No post-hoc hierarchy, no claim of uniformly available signal. Learning curves descriptive only.
level2.multiplicity: Holm is weakly more powerful than Bonferroni for valid p-values, not strictly better on every dataset. It is not applicable directly to the old approximate bootstrap lower bounds as though they were valid p-values. Retain v3 engineering bounds; do not switch their correction in response to outcomes.

planning.model: Exact one-sided iid binomial sensitivity vs .5, equal success probability, not cluster-aware actual power or confirmatory inference. Pooled alpha .0125 represents first Holm threshold/worst-case Bonferroni; conditioned alpha .05/13 is prior engineering comparison illustration.
planning.cluster_warning: At 13 independent bounded family scores, Hoeffding first Holm threshold requires mean >=.5+sqrt(log(80)/(2*13)) about .9105; conservative and not a forecast of actual power. Correlation for probe correctness is not ICC of future G3-G2 paired differences. Need final F and separate family-aware planning assumptions; no empirical ICC or G3 discordance yet. Do not claim iid 80% applies to actual cluster-aware analysis.

noninferiority.delta_10pp: Illustration only, no domain/utility justification. Do not freeze margin or use NI as fallback until justified prospectively, with protected zero-loss unchanged. No NI test or claim permitted now.
